Norway bid farewell to King Harald V on Wednesday, as crowds lined the streets of Oslo and foreign royals and world leaders gathered for the funeral of the long-serving monarch.
ADVERTISEMENT ADVERTISEMENT A 21-gun salute rang out over the Norwegian capital as the funeral procession made its way from the Royal Palace to Oslo Cathedral.
Harald’s son, the new King Haakon VIII, and other senior royals walked behind the coffin, which was draped in the red Norwegian royal standard.
Harald’s widow, Queen Sonja, and Haakon’s wife, Queen Mette-Marit, followed by car.
There it will be lowered into the crypt of the royal mausoleum, next to Harald's parents and grandparents.
Once the burial is completed, flags across the country, which were lowered to half-mast after Harald's death, will once again be raised and church bells will ring for an hour.
Norway's police force has mobilised nearly 3,000 officers in what it has described as "one of the biggest operations" in its history.
Until his death, Harald, who ascended the throne in 1991, was the oldest reigning monarch in Europe.
Embodying an open and tolerant Norway, he made a deep impression by celebrating diversity in a 2016 speech marking the 25th anniversary of his reign.

sentences: King Harald V’s Coffin will leave the Royal Palace on Wednesday, September 9 at 12:00 and be taken in procession to Oslo Cathedral.
At 1:00 p.m., King Harald V will be laid to rest in Oslo Cathedral.

Their Majesties the King and Queen will hold a reception at the Palace after the funeral ceremony, which will be attended by representatives of official Norway, visiting Heads of State, Royals and Family.
Royal Guests and Heads of State who have confirmed their attendance: Six Kings and Ten Queens led the Royal Guests and Relatives at the Funeral of King Olav V of Norway in 1991.
Foreign Royalty, Heads of State and Prime Ministers, representatives of official Norway and representatives of the Royal Court also participate in the procession.
Olav Fykse Tveit and will follow the Church of Norway’s funeral arrangements.
Cathedral Cantor Marcus André Berg will lead the church music together with the Oslo Cathedral Choir.
King Harald’s family and close friends will be present.
The entire official Norwegian government will be represented, along with guests representing the breadth of King Harald’s life and work.
The Coffin is followed by His Majesty the King , Her Majesty the Queen , Her Royal Highness Crown Princess Ingrid Alexandra , Queen Sonja , Prince Sverre Magnus and Princess Märtha Louise .
Oslo Bishop Sunniva Gylver will also contribute.
There will also be Royal Guests and Heads of State from a number of countries.
After the funeral, the coffin will be taken in procession to Akershus Castle Church.
The bier is lowered into the crypt in the Palace Church, where the two sarcophagi of King Haakon, Queen Maud, King Olav and Crown Princess Märtha are.
After the ceremony in Akershus Castle Church, His Majesty the King and Her Majesty the Queen will come out into the courtyard of Akershus Fortress.

His Majesty the King, Her Majesty the Queen, Her Royal Highness the Crown Princess, Queen Sonja and Prince Sverre Magnus drive back to the Royal Palace along the same route that the procession has taken.
After arriving back at the Palace, Norway’s new royal couple, Her Royal Highness the Crown Princess, Queen Sonja and Prince Sverre Magnus, will appear on the Palace balcony.

sentences: Márcanos como medio preferente Añádenos en Google Gemma Casadevall Berlín 09 SEPT 2026 14:50 Actualizada 09 SEPT 2026 17:39 Por qué confiar en El Periódico Por qué confiar en El Periódico Miles de ciudadanos noruegos siguieron este miércoles a pie de calle, en Oslo, o a través de pantallas gigantes el funeral por Harald V, fallecido el pasado 28 de agosto a los 89 años .
El hijo mayor de la reina consorte acudió este miércoles al funeral de la catedral de Oslo.
Unas horas después del funeral, su hijo Haakon VII salió al balcón para el saludo protocolario a los noruegos, con las campanas de toda Noruega repicando en su honor.

Despligue de seguridad en torno a líderes y realeza Por todo el centro de Oslo se había desplegado este miércoles un fuerte dispositivo de seguridad por la presencia de representantes de casas reales de toda Europa y líderes políticos, principalmente de países nórdicos y bálticos, así como el presidente ucraniano, Volodímir Zelenski .
Los actos empezaron con el traslado del féretro de Harald a lo largo del kilómetro que media entre el Palacio Real y la catedral.
Les seguían en coche la reina consorte Mette-Marit, convaleciente de su transplante de pulmón, y la reina Sonia, viuda de Harald.
Para muchos noruegos, pervive en la memoria la imagen de la familia real en pleno, encabezada por Harald, en ese mismo templo, tras el impacto por el doble atentado de Breivik.
Unos días después, el rey Harald tocó la fibra de los noruegos en un discurso histórico, luchando con las lágrimas y compartiendo el dolor traumático de todo el país.
Tenía por entonces cinco años y Harald le acogió como a sus nietos, los hijos de Haakon o los de la princesa Marta Luisa .

Las salvas y los honores a Haakon VIII Finalizado el funeral de la catedral, el féretro fue transportado en procesión hasta la capilla de Akershus para su entierro, mientras cuatro cazas F-35 de las fuerzas aéreas noruegas sobrevolaban la catedral.
En la capilla están ya los sarcógrafos de reyes antecesores, como Olav y Marta, los padres de Harald.

Las banderas de todo el país, a media asta desde el fallecimiento de Harald V, fueron izadas de nuevo, entre desfiles militares y mientras la familia real se dirigía a su balcón de palacio para saludar a conciudadanos.
